titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Zion's Garment and the Road Home (ch. 51–52)
part: ch. 51–52 — Zion's Garment and the Road Home
about: Solomon sends Zadok to bring Zion's garment, its fringe and its keepsakes to Menelik, with a message that the Ark be honoured, sworn by and prayed towards; Zadok's son Azarias hints at the true Lady, a covenant is made for his house, and the company sets out under Michael's guidance, carried above the ground across sea and land.

sentences.t: ፶፩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዘይቤሎ ፡ ለሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ሑር ፡ ወአምጽእ ፡ ውእተ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ዘላዕሌሃ ።
sentences.l: 51. Where that-which-he-said-to-him to-Zadok priest: go and-bring that garment which-upon-her
sentences.i: Chapter 51: Where he said to Zadok the priest: 'Go and bring that garment which is upon her'
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ ዘ- 'where / at the point where' (ዘ- 'that which' + verb); ch. 49 has the same heading form with a bare verb (ኀበ ባረኮ). ዘይቤሎ 'what he said to him' (ዘ- + ይቤ + -ሎ). ሑር is a spelling of the imperative ሖር 'go' (ሖረ), written ሖር in the next unit. ልብሰ 'garment' is accusative (ending -ä, written ሰ), object of አምጽእ 'bring!'. ዘላዕሌሃ 'which (is) upon her' (ዘ- + ላዕሌ- 'upon' + -ሃ 'her'): the garment on Zion, the Ark. The speaker is Solomon (the 'her' is Zion, feminine).

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ለሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ሖር ፡ አምጽእ ፡ ውእተ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ዘላዕሌሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወንሣእ ፡ ለከ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ልብሰዘይኄይስ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ወአልብሳ ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ፪ ፡ ዘታሕቴሃ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him to-Zadok priest: go, bring that garment which-upon-her, to-Zion, and-take for-you this garment-which-is-better than-it, and-clothe-her over the-two which-beneath-her;
sentences.i: And he said to Zadok the priest: 'Go, bring that garment that is upon Zion, and take for yourself this garment, which is better than it, and clothe her over the two that are beneath her;
sentences.n: Imperatives throughout: ሖር 'go', አምጽእ 'bring' (አምጽአ, causative of መጽአ 'come'), ንሣእ 'take' (ወንሣእ), ወአልብሳ 'and clothe her' (imperative of the causative አልበሰ + -ኣ 'her', written -ሳ). ለጽዮን: ለ- 'to/for' marks the owner, 'the garment ... of Zion'. ለከ 'for yourself'. SOURCE ODDITY: ልብሰዘይኄይስ is printed as one word; read ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ 'a garment which is better' (ኀየሰ 'be good, be better'; ይኄይስ 3ms imperfect), and እምኔሁ 'than it' (the comparative እም-): the garment is 'better than' the one on Zion. What is done with the garment brought from her is not stated. መልዕልተ ፪ 'over the two', ዘታሕቴሃ 'that are beneath her': I take it that two earlier coverings lie under the new one, so that the new garment goes on top (?); the figure ፪ is the Ethiopic digit 2 (ክልኤቱ).

sentences.t: ወውእቱ ፡ ልብስ ፡ ዘዐሥቅ ፡ ወርቀ ፡ ቄፋዝ ፡ ዝብጦ ፡ ወእኑም ፡ በስህቦ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ዘፍትሎ ፡ ዘሜላት ፤
sentences.l: And-it garment which-woven (?) gold, ቄፋዝ (?) its-ዝብጥ (?), and-እኑም (?) by-drawing, and-not which-twisting of-ሜላት (?);
sentences.i: That garment is one worked (?) with gold, ... (?) ... drawn out (?), and not by the twisting of ... (?);
sentences.n: ወውእቱ 'and it / that one'. ዘዐሥቅ ወርቀ: ዘ- 'which' + a word I read as 'woven, worked' (ዐሠቀ) + ወርቀ 'gold' (accusative): 'worked with gold'. The remaining words are technical weaving terms I cannot fix from the lexicon: ቄፋዝ, ዝብጦ, ወእኑም, ዘሜላት. ስህቦ 'drawing, pulling' (ሰሐበ 'draw, drag') and ፍትሎ 'twisting' (ፈተለ 'twist, spin') are clear; the contrast seems to be 'drawn (wire?) gold' as against 'twisted thread'. Only the contrast, not the terms, is rendered (?).

sentences.t: ወ፭ ፡ እሞጻሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ አናጹት ፡ ወ፲ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ነፍስቶሙ ፡ ዘገብሩ ፡ ቤዛሆሙ ፡ መኳንንተ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፤
sentences.l: And-5 from-her-ሞጻ (?) to-Zion, አናጹት (?), and-10 likenesses-of their-selves which-they-made their-ransom, princes-of Philistines;
sentences.i: Of Zion's fringe (?), five are ... (?), and ten are likenesses of themselves, which the princes of the Philistines made as their ransom;
sentences.n: ወ፭ 'and five', ወ፲ 'and ten' (Ethiopic digits, as ፭ = ኀምስቱ, ፲ = ዐሠርቱ). እሞጻሃ: እም 'of / from' + ሞጻ + -ሃ 'her': ሞጻ I take, from the sense of the next lines, as the 'hem, fringe' of a garment (?) — bells hang on the hem of Aaron's robe in Exodus 28:33–34, but the word ሞጻ is not found there — so 'five from her (Zion's) fringe'. The same guess is kept for ሞጻ in units 13 and 25. አናጹት is unknown to me (?). The Philistine offering is 1 Samuel 6:4–5, 17–18, where the Philistine lords return the Ark with five golden tumours (?) and five golden mice; so 'five ... and ten' may mean five such and ten likenesses together with them. አምሳለ ነፍስቶሙ 'likeness of their souls/selves' (አምሳል construct); ዘገብሩ 'which they made'; ቤዛሆሙ 'as their ransom' (ቤዛ + -ሆሙ); መኳንንተ ኢሎፍሊ 'princes of the Philistines', a construct chain in apposition. The sense is held loosely (?).

sentences.t: ወእምጸናጽል ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ዘወፅአ ፡ እምደረ ፡ ቃዴስ ፡ ዘተአዘዞ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በሲና ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ጸናጽለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ አሮን ፡ እኁሁ ።
sentences.l: And-from-bells likeness-of gold which-went-out from-ደር-of Kadesh, which-it-was-commanded to-Moses on-Sinai that-he-make bells on garment-of Aaron his-brother.
sentences.i: And of the bells, a golden likeness, which came out of the ... of Kadesh (?), as Moses was commanded on Sinai to make bells on the garment of Aaron his brother.
sentences.n: ጸናጽል 'bells, rattles' (also the sistrum); the allusion is Exodus 28:33–35, golden bells on the hem of the high priest's robe, and the commandment given to Moses on Sinai. ዘወፅአ 'which went out' (ዘ- + ወፅአ, 3ms perfect). እምደረ ቃዴስ: እም 'from'; ደረ is construct; ደር I take as 'hill-country / region' (?); Kadesh is the place of Numbers 20, so the link of the golden likeness to Kadesh is the source's own and unclear (?). ዘተአዘዞ ለሙሴ 'which was commanded to Moses' (ተአዘዘ passive + -ኦ; ለ- marks the person). ከመ ይግበር 'that he make' (jussive). ጸናጽለ 'bells' (accusative). ልብሰ አሮን እኁሁ 'garment-of Aaron his brother'.

sentences.t: ወአስተጋብኦን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብሳ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወሰድ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ለወልድየ ፡ ዳዊት ፤
sentences.l: And-gather-them into garment-of-her to-Zion, and-send to-him, to-my-son David;
sentences.i: Gather them into the garment of Zion, and send them to him, to my son David;
sentences.n: ወአስተጋብኦን: imperative of አስተጋብአ 'gather together' (causative-reflexive stem) + -ን '(f.) them'; ወ- 'and' begins a new command, so read as 'and gather them'. The things gathered are the fringe-pieces and likenesses of the previous two units. ልብሳ ለጽዮን 'her garment, Zion's' (suffix doubled by ለ-). ወሰድ 'and send' (ሰደደ 'send, drive away'; imperative) with ሎቱ 'to him' repeated by ለወልድየ ዳዊት 'to my son David'. David is Menelik, who has taken his father's name as king; the speaker is Solomon.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ትቤ ፡ እሙ ፡ በመልእክተ ፡ ተምሪን ፡ ገብራ ፡ ሀበነአእምዘፈረ ፡ ልብሳ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ከመ ፡ ናምልካ ፡ ኪያሃ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ወእለ ፡ እምታሕቴነ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ መንግሥትነ ፤
sentences.l: for said his-mother by-message-of Tamrin her-servant: give-us ... from-the-fringe (?)-of her-garment to-Zion, that-we-worship her, we and-those beneath-us and-all our-kingdom;
sentences.i: For his mother said, by the message of Tamrin her servant: 'Give us a piece of the fringe (?) of Zion's garment, that we may worship her, we and those under us and all our kingdom;
sentences.n: እስመ 'for'. ትቤ 'she said' (ትቤ is the 3fs of ይቤ, 'said'); እሙ 'his mother' (እም + -ሁ), Makeda. በመልእክተ ተምሪን 'by the message (or letter) of Tamrin', Tamrin the merchant, here called ገብራ 'her servant'. SOURCE ODDITY: ሀበነአእምዘፈረ is printed as one word. I read ሀበነ 'give us' + a stray አ (as in the Queen's messages of ch. 33–36) + እም 'from' + ዘፈረ 'fringe of' (ዘፈር 'edge, fringe', the published guess from the sense (?)). The parallel in the next unit, ሀበነ ዘናመልክ እምዘፈረ ልብሳ, confirms 'from the fringe of her garment'. ከመ ናምልካ ኪያሃ: ናምልካ 'we may worship her' (ከመ + 1cp subjunctive of አምለከ 'worship' + -ኣ 'her', written -ካ), ኪያሃ 'her' the doubled independent object. ንሕነ 'we', ወእለ እምታሕቴነ 'and those under us', ወኵሉ መንግሥትነ 'and all our kingdom'. The quoted speech opens here and runs through the end of the part's message.

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ሀቦ ፡ ወበሎ ፡ ንሥኣአ ፡ አምልካ ፡ ለዛቲ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ እስመ ፡ ለአከት ፡ እምከ ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ ወለሊከኒ ፡ ትቤ ፡ ሀበነ ፡ ዘናመልክ ፡ እምዘፈረ ፡ ልብሳ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢናምልክ ፡ ባዕደ ፡ ከመ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
sentences.l: And-now give-him and-say-to-him: take (it), worship to-this garment-of Zion, for she-sent your-mother because-of-this; and-you-yourself said: give-us what we-worship from-the-fringe (?)-of her-garment, that-not we-worship another like nations.
sentences.i: And now give it to him and say to him: Take this garment of Zion and worship it, for your mother sent for this reason; and you yourself said, Give us something to worship from the fringe (?) of her garment, so that we should not worship another, like the nations.'
sentences.n: ሀቦ 'give him' (imperative ሀብ + -ሁ 'him'); ወበሎ 'and say to him' (imperative በል + -ሎ). ንሥኣአ is printed with a doubled final አ (and below, ንሣእአ); read ንሣእ 'take' with -ኣ 'it' or a stray አ (?). አምልካ 'worship her/it' (imperative), the object doubled by ለዛቲ ልብሰ ጽዮን 'to this garment of Zion' (ለ- marks the object). Notice that the worship of the garment is the mother's own wish. ለአከት 'she sent' (ለአከ, 3fs); እምከ 'your mother' (እም + -ከ). በእንተዝ 'for this reason'. ወለሊከኒ 'and you yourself too' (ለሊከ 'yourself' + -ኒ). ዘናመልክ 'which we worship / may worship'. ከመ ኢናምልክ ባዕደ 'that we not worship another' (ከመ ኢ- with the subjunctive); ከመ አሕዛብ 'like the nations'. The speaker quoted to Menelik is Solomon's message, and the quotation marks open and close only by sense.

sentences.t: ወጽዮንሂ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ትኩንከ ፡ መርሐ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ሀለውከ ፤
sentences.l: And-Zion-indeed, ark-of his-law of-God, she-will-be-to-you guide, where you-are;
sentences.i: And Zion, the ark of the law of God, will be a guide to you wherever you are;
sentences.n: ጽዮንሂ: ጽዮን + ሂ (emphatic 'indeed, as for'). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'ark of his law, of God' in apposition to Zion: ሕጉ is ሕግ + -ሁ 'his law', then ለእግዚኣብሔር names the owner (a doubled possessive: 'his law, God's'). ታቦተ is the construct/accusative form of ታቦት 'ark'. This is the Zion = Ark theology of the book. ትኩንከ 'she will be to you' (ትኩን 3fs + -ከ), መርሐ 'a guide' (accusative, predicate); በኀበ ሀለውከ 'where you were/are' (ሀሎ 'to be' perfect, 2ms; the perfect here is a general present, 'wherever you are').

sentences.t: ወለነሰ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ወትረ ፡ ኀቤነ ፡ ወኢናስተጠናቅቅ ፡ አክብሮታ ፡ ወአንትሙሰ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ኢሀለወት ፡ ኀቤክሙ ፡ ታከብርዋ ፡ በአስተጠናቅቆ ፤
sentences.l: And-for-us-indeed, she-was always with-us, and-not we-take-care her-honouring; and-you-indeed, while not she-was with-you, you-honour-her with-care;
sentences.i: But with us she was always present, and we did not take exact care over honouring her; whereas you, though she was not with you, honour her with careful attention;
sentences.n: ወለነሰ 'and as for us' (ወ- + ለነ 'to us' + -ሰ 'as for'); ሀለወት 'she was' (ሀሎ, 3fs perfect); ወትረ 'always'; ኀቤነ 'with us' (ኀበ + -ነ). ኢናስተጠናቅቅ: ኢ- 'not' + አስተጠናቀቀ 'be scrupulous, take exact care' (a quadriliteral reflexive stem, ጠነቀቀ) in the 1pl imperfect; አክብሮታ 'her honouring' (አክብሮት, a verbal noun, + -ኣ 'her'). The mood, 'we do not trouble to be exact about honouring her', is reproachful (?). ወአንትሙሰ 'and you (pl.) indeed', እንዘ ኢሀለወት ኀቤክሙ 'while she was not with you'; ታከብርዋ 'you honour her' (አክበረ + -ዋ 'her'); በአስተጠናቅቆ 'with exactness, with careful attention' (verbal noun of the same stem).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለኤሊ ፡ ካህን ፡ በአፈ ፡ ሳሙኤል ፡ ነቢይ ፡ አነ ፡ ፈቀድኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትንበሩ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወቤተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትዕጥኑ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕግየ ፡ ወትንበሩ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወይእዜሰ ፡ ተነሳሕኩ ፡ እመይጥ ፡ ገጽየ ፡ እምኔከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተዐውሮ ፡ ተዐወርከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ መሥዋዕትየ ፡ ወአፍቀርከ ፡ ደቂቅከ ፡ እምኔየ ፤
sentences.l: For said-to-him God to-Eli priest by-the-mouth-of Samuel prophet: I desired that you-abide, you and-house-of your-father, that you-burn-incense ark-of my-law and-you-abide before-me until for-ever; and-now-indeed I-repented, I-will-turn my-face from-you, for you-were-hardened-indeed (?), you-were-hardened (?), over my-sacrifice, and-you-loved your-sons more-than-me;
sentences.i: For God said to Eli the priest by the mouth of Samuel the prophet: 'I wished that you and your father's house should abide, and burn incense at the ark of my law, and abide before me for ever; but now I have repented. I will turn my face from you, for you have been stubborn (?) against my sacrifice, and you loved your sons more than me;
sentences.n: The allusion is 1 Samuel 2:27–30 (the word to Eli, there spoken by a 'man of God'; the book credits Samuel, cf. 1 Samuel 3:11–14); the book uses it as a warning: those who do not honour the Ark lose it. ይቤሎ 'he said to him' (ይቤ + -ሎ), ለኤሊ ካህን 'to Eli the priest'; በአፈ ሳሙኤል ነቢይ 'by the mouth of Samuel the prophet' (አፍ construct አፈ). ፈቀድኩ 'I wished' (1cs); ከመ ትንበሩ 'that you (pl.) dwell, remain'; ትዕጥኑ ታቦተ ሕግየ 'you burn incense (to/before) the ark of my law'; ትንበሩ ቅድሜየ 'you abide before me' (the same verb ነበረ as in ከመ ትንበሩ); እስከ ለዓለም 'for ever'. ወይእዜሰ 'and now indeed'. ተነሳሕኩ 'I have repented' (ተነሳሐ, 1cs); እመይጥ ገጽየ እምኔከ 'I will turn my face from you'. ተዐውሮ ተዐወርከ is an infinitive-plus-finite emphasis ('you were truly ...'); ተዐወረ is of uncertain root, perhaps from ዐወረ 'be blind' (so ch. 44 ተዐወሮ 'hardened against (?)' and ch. 46–48 ይትዔወራ), hence 'you have been stubborn (?) against my sacrifice'; the Greek of 1 Samuel 2:29 has 'a shameless eye' towards the sacrifice, which suits a sense of contempt. ላዕለ መሥዋዕትየ 'over my sacrifice'. ወአፍቀርከ ደቂቅከ እምኔየ 'and you loved your sons more than me' (አፍቀረ 'love', with እም- comparative).

sentences.t: ወይእዜሰ ፡ ለዘ ፡ አክበረኒ ፡ ኣከብሮ ፡ ወለዘ ፡ አስተሐቀረኒ ፡ ኣስተሐቅሮ ፡ ወእስዕር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘርእከ ፤
sentences.l: And-now-indeed to-whom he-honoured-me I-will-honour, and-to-whom he-despised-me I-will-despise, and-I-will-uproot all your-seed;
sentences.i: And now, whoever honoured me I will honour, and whoever despised me I will despise, and I will root out all your seed;
sentences.n: Still the word to Eli (1 Samuel 2:30, 'those who honour me I will honour, and those who despise me shall be lightly esteemed'). ለዘ 'to the one who' (ለ- marking the object + ዘ-), አክበረኒ 'he honoured me' (አክበረ + -ኒ), ኣከብሮ 'I will honour him' (1cs imperfect, written with ኣ, the 1cs prefix, + -ሁ), አስተሐቀረኒ 'he despised me', ኣስተሐቅሮ 'I will despise him' (the same). ወእስዕር 'and I will uproot, wipe out' (ሰዐረ, 1cs imperfect, 'uproot, destroy'); ኵሎ ዘርእከ 'all your seed' (ዘር + -ከ).

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘአስተሐቀርዎ ፡ ሌዋውያን ።
sentences.l: And-this which-he-said concerning that-they-despised-him the-Levites.
sentences.i: And he said this concerning the Levites, who had despised him (?).
sentences.n: ወዘንተ ዘይቤ 'and this which he said'; በእንተ ዘ- 'concerning that which'; ዘአስተሐቀርዎ ሌዋውያን 'which the Levites despised (him)' — አስተሐቀረ + -ዎ 'him', then ሌዋውያን 'Levites' (plural of ሌዋዊ) as subject; a loose clause that I render as 'the Levites, who had despised him'. Who 'him' is (God, or the Ark) is not clear (?). The Levites are the temple servants who looked after the Ark, and the thought is that their neglect lost it.

sentences.t: ወበሎ ፡ ንሣእአ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ልብሳ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወዘንተኒ ፡ ሞጻ ፡ ይኩኖ ፡ ህየንቴሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወአንብሮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራከ ፤
sentences.l: And-say-to-him: take this garment-of-her to-Zion, and-this-also ሞጻ (?) let-it-be-to-him in-place-of-her to-Zion, and-set-it in your-tent;
sentences.i: And say to him: Take this garment of Zion, and let this fringe (?) also be for him in the place of Zion, and set it in your tent;
sentences.n: A second set of instructions for Menelik's message. ወበሎ 'and say to him'; ንሣእአ again with the doubled final አ; ዘንተኒ ሞጻ 'this also, the fringe' (ሞጻ 'hem, fringe (?)', see unit 3). ይኩኖ 'let it be for him' (ይኩን jussive + -ኖ), the person shifts mid-message from 'him' to 'your tent' (?). ህየንቴሃ ለጽዮን 'in her place, Zion's' (ህየንተ 'instead of' + -ሃ). ወአንብሮ 'and set it' (imperative አንብር 'place' + -ሁ). ደብተራከ 'your tent' (ደብተራ, the tent of meeting).

sentences.t: ወሶበኒ ፡ ትምሕል ፡ ወታምሕል ፡ መሐል ፡ ወአምሕል ፡ ባቲ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትዝክር ፡ አስማተ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ አሕዛብ ፤
sentences.l: And-whenever you-swear and-you-cause-to-swear, swear and-cause-to-swear by-her, that-not you-mention names-of another, gods-of nations;
sentences.i: And whenever you swear, or make others swear, swear, and make them swear, by her, so that you do not mention the names of another, the gods of the nations;
sentences.n: ወሶበኒ 'and whenever' (ሶበ 'when' + -ኒ). ትምሕል 'you swear' (መሐለ), ወታምሕል 'and you cause to swear' (አምሕለ causative), መሐል 'swear!' (G imperative, as in ch. 29–30; a noun 'an oath' after ትምሕል is the other possibility (?)); ወአምሕል ባቲ 'and make swear by her' (imperative of the causative አምሕለ + ባቲ 'in/by her'). ከመ ኢትዝክር አስማተ ባዕድ 'that you not mention the names of another', with አማልክተ አሕዛብ 'gods of nations' in apposition (Exodus 23:13, the command not to mention the names of other gods). So Zion becomes the sole oath.

sentences.t: ወሶበኒ ፡ ትሠውዕ ፡ አንጺረከ ፡ ለኀቤነ ፡ ሡዕ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ወለጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ወሶበኒ ፡ ትጼሊ ፡ አንጺረከ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ለኀቤነ ፡ ጸሊ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-whenever you-sacrifice, having-looked toward-us, sacrifice to-Jerusalem and-to-Zion holy; and-whenever you-pray, having-looked to-Jerusalem, toward-us pray. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: And whenever you sacrifice, looking towards us, sacrifice to Jerusalem and to holy Zion; and whenever you pray, looking to Jerusalem, pray towards us.' ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.n: ትሠውዕ 'you sacrifice', ትጼሊ 'you pray'; አንጺረከ 'having looked' (አንጸረ 'look towards', 2ms converb), the posture of direction in prayer (cf. 1 Kings 8:44, 48, praying towards the city). ለኀቤነ 'towards us', ሡዕ 'sacrifice!', ጸሊ 'pray!' (imperatives). The close of Solomon's message; the nine ፨ close the chapter.

sentences.t: ፶፪ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዘሖረ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ።
sentences.l: 52. Where that-he-went Zadok priest.
sentences.i: Chapter 52: Where Zadok the priest went
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ ዘሖረ 'where he went' (ሖረ, 3ms perfect), the same pattern as ch. 51.

sentences.t: ወሖረ ፡ ሳዶቅካህን ፡ ወወሀቦ ፡ ልብሳ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወአዘዘ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘነገሮ ፡ ሰሎሞን ።
sentences.l: And-went Zadok-priest and-gave-him garment-of-her to-Zion, and-commanded all what-told-him Solomon.
sentences.i: Zadok the priest went and gave him the garment of Zion, and charged him with everything that Solomon had told him.
sentences.n: SOURCE ODDITY: ሳዶቅካህን is printed as one word, ሳዶቅ ካህን 'Zadok the priest'. ወሀቦ 'and he gave him' (ወሀበ + -ሁ). ልብሳ ለጽዮን 'Zion's garment'. ወአዘዘ 'and he commanded' (አዘዘ), here 'he relayed the orders'; ዘነገሮ 'what he told him' (ነገረ). The one given the garment is Menelik, called David.

sentences.t: ወተፈሥሐ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ ወአንከረ ፡ ወአስተብፅዐ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ትኩነኒ ፡ እግዝእትየ ፡ በተአምኖታ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: And-rejoiced David son-of Solomon because-of-this and-marvelled and-blessed (?) exceedingly and-said: this-one she-will-be-to-me my-lady, by-believing-her to-the-ark-of law-of God.
sentences.i: David, the son of Solomon, rejoiced at this, and marvelled, and gave great praise (?), and said: 'She shall be my lady, through trust in the ark of the law of God.'
sentences.n: ወተፈሥሐ 'and he rejoiced' (ተፈሥሐ), ዳዊት ወልደ ሰሎሞን 'David, son of Solomon' (Menelik). ወአንከረ 'and he marvelled' (አንከረ). ወአስተብፅዐ: ብፁዕ is 'blessed', and the causative-reflexive stem should mean 'to call blessed, to praise' (?). ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. ዛቲ 'this (f.)', ትኩነኒ 'she will be to me' (ትኩን + -ኒ), እግዝእትየ 'my lady' (the Ark/Zion). በተአምኖታ ለታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር is difficult: ተአምኖት is 'belief, trust' + -ኣ 'her' (written -ታ, as ጽዒኖታ in ch. 49), with ለ- doubling the possessor, the Ark; I read 'by trust in the ark ...' (?).

sentences.t: ወአውሥአ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ተፈሣሕከ ፡ በልብስ ፡ ወእፎ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ እምተፈሣሕከ ፡ በእግዝእተ ፡ ልብስ ።
sentences.l: And-answered Azarias and-said before his-father: you-rejoiced in-garment, and-how more than-you-rejoiced in-lady-of garment.
sentences.i: Azarias answered and said, in the presence of his father: 'You rejoiced over a garment; how much more would you rejoice (?) over the lady of the garment!'
sentences.n: አዛርያስ (Azariah), the son of Zadok; በቅድመ አቡሁ 'before his father' (Zadok; ቅድመ construct 'before'). ወአውሥአ 'and he answered' (አውሥአ). ተፈሣሕከ 'you rejoiced' (2ms), the same verb as in the last unit, with the ሣ/ሥ spelling variant. ወእፎ ፈድፋደ እምተፈሣሕከ 'and how much more than you rejoiced' — I take the clause as an exclamation, 'how much more [will you rejoice] than you rejoiced' (?); the second ተፈሣሕከ is the standard of comparison. በእግዝእተ ልብስ 'in the lady of the garment' (the Ark itself, as against its cover). The hint is that the Ark is with them; the reader is meant to catch it.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ በአማን ፡ እምተፈሥሐ ፡ በእግዝእተ ፡ ልብስ ፡ ወእምቀነየነ ፡ ለኵልነ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ኢየሐውር ፡ ብሔሮ ።
sentences.l: And-said-to-him his-father: in-truth than-he-rejoiced in-lady-of garment, and-than-he-subdued-us for-all-of-us, when not he-goes his-country.
sentences.i: And his father said to him: 'In truth, more than he rejoiced over the lady of the garment, and more than he subdued us all, when he does not go to his own country' (the sense is not recovered (?)).
sentences.n: The reading of this unit is uncertain (?). በአማን 'in truth'. እምተፈሥሐ 'than he rejoiced' or 'he has rejoiced': እም- before a finite verb can be comparative ('more than') or a form of እመ 'if' (?). ወእምቀነየነ ለኵልነ: ቀነየ with an object is 'subdue' (ch. 25–26 ቀነዮሙ 'he subdued them'), so 'than he subdued us, all of us' or 'since he subdued us'; the ለኵልነ 'for all of us' stresses that it is all of the party. ሶበ ኢየሐውር ብሔሮ 'when / if he does not go (to) his country' (ብሔሮ, ብሔር + -ሁ, accusative). I take the speaker to be Zadok answering Azarias, and 'he' the king; no main clause is recoverable and I offer no smooth reading (?).

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ሀበኒኬ ፡ ኪዳነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሀቦ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ እግዝእቱ ፡ ለትሕቢቱወምዕቅብናሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትመሐፀን ፡ ኵሎ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሕይወቱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወለዘርኡ ፡ እምድኅሬሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said to-the-king: give-me-indeed a-covenant that you-give to-this my-son this property-of his-lady, for-his-ትሕቢት (?) and-his-guarding, that-he-be-protected (?) all days-of his-life, he and-for-his-seed after-him;
sentences.i: And he said to the king: 'Grant me a covenant, that you give to this my son the property of his lady, to keep and guard it (?), that he may be sheltered (?) all the days of his life, he and his seed after him;
sentences.n: ሀበኒኬ 'give me, then' (ሀበ imperative + -ኒ + -ኬ 'indeed'); ኪዳነ 'a covenant' (ኪዳን, accusative). ከመ ተሀቦ 'that you give him' (jussive). ለዝንቱ ወልድየ 'to this my son' (Azarias); ንዋየ እግዝእቱ 'the property (vessels, furnishings) of his lady' (ንዋይ construct). SOURCE ODDITY: ለትሕቢቱወምዕቅብናሁ is printed as one word; read ለትሕቢቱ ወምዕቅብናሁ. ምዕቅብ is 'guarding', ትሕቢት I cannot place (? 'keeping', or 'concealing'); the point is custody of the Ark's furniture. ይትመሐፀን: ተመሐፀነ 'take refuge, be protected' (?); read as 'be provided for / sheltered'. ኵሎ መዋዕለ ሕይወቱ 'all the days of his life'. ሎቱ ወለዘርኡ እምድኅሬሁ 'for him and for his seed after him'.

sentences.t: ወዓሥራትኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሀቦ ፡ ወሀገረ ፡ ምስካይኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ የሀቦ ፡ በውስተ ፡ መንግሥትከ ፡ ወለዐሥራተ ፡ አህጉርኒ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መንግሥቱ ፤
sentences.l: And-tithes-too that you-give-him, and-city-of ምስካይ (?) too that he-give-him in your-kingdom, and-for-tithes-of cities in-all his-kingdom;
sentences.i: And tithes too, that you give him, and a city of refuge (?) too, that he give him in your kingdom, and for the tithes of cities in all his kingdom;
sentences.n: ወዓሥራትኒ 'and tithes too' (ዓሥራት 'tithe', from ዐሥር 'ten', + -ኒ). ሀገረ ምስካይ: ሀገር construct 'city of' + ምስካይ, which I read as a 'dwelling/refuge' (?) — a city of refuge in the sense of Numbers 35. የሀቦ 'let him give him' (3ms jussive): subject is the king, but በውስተ መንግሥትከ 'in your kingdom' and then በኵሉ መንግሥቱ 'in all his kingdom' make the person shift (?). ለዐሥራተ አህጉርኒ 'and for the tithes of the cities' (አህጉር plural of ሀገር).

sentences.t: ወውእቱኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩንከ ፡ ካህነ ፡ ወራእየ ፡ ወነቢየ ፡ ወመሃሬ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለዘርእከ ፡ እምድኅሬከ ፡ ወቀባኤ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ መንግሥትኒ ፡ ለደቂቅከ ፡ ወለደቂቀ ፡ ደቂቅከ ።
sentences.l: And-he-too that he-be-to-you priest and-seer and-prophet and-teacher, to-you and-to-your-seed after-you, and-anointer anointing-of kingdom for-your-sons and-for-sons-of your-sons.
sentences.i: And that he be your priest, seer, prophet and teacher, for you and your seed after you, and anointer, with the anointing of kingship, of your sons and your sons' sons.'
sentences.n: ወውእቱኒ 'and he too'; ከመ ይኩንከ 'that he be to you' (ይኩን + -ከ). ካህነ ወራእየ ወነቢየ ወመሃሬ 'as priest and seer and prophet and teacher' — all accusative predicates. ቀባኤ ቅብአ መንግሥት 'anointer with the anointing of kingship' (ቀባኤ, 'one who anoints'; ቅብእ construct, as in 1 Samuel 10:1), a priestly right to crown the royal line. ለደቂቅከ ወለደቂቀ ደቂቅከ 'for your sons and for the sons of your sons'; ደቂቀ construct. This closes Zadok's request.

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ ኦሆ ።
sentences.l: And-he-said: yes.
sentences.i: And he said: 'Yes.'
sentences.n: ኦሆ 'yes', the particle which in ch. 36 and 38 is attached to an obscure phrase; here it stands alone and is plain: the king agrees to Zadok's requests. The speaker is not named: the king, Menelik.

sentences.t: ወተካየዱ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ሞጻ ፡ ወልብሳ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወቃማ ፡ ዘወርቅ ፨
sentences.l: And-they-made-a-covenant, and-took from-with his-father the-ሞጻ (?) and-garment-of her to-Zion and-a-ቃማ (?) of-gold. ፨
sentences.i: They made the covenant, and he took from his father the fringe (?) and the garment of Zion, and a ... of gold (?). ፨
sentences.n: ወተካየዱ 'and they made a covenant' (ተካየደ, reciprocal stem, 'came to terms with one another'). ነሥአ 'he took'; እምኀበ አቡሁ 'from (with) his father' — most likely Azarias taking from his father Zadok what the covenant of the last units makes over to him (Solomon, Menelik's father, is not present) (?). ሞጻ ወልብሳ ለጽዮን 'the fringe and Zion's garment'. ቃማ ዘወርቅ 'a ቃማ of gold' is an unknown object (?). The single ፨ here ends the unit in the printed text, mid-narrative.

sentences.t: ወጸዐኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሖሩ ፡ ሰረገላተ ፡ ወአፍራሰ ፡ ወአብቅልተ ፡ ወተሠርሐ ፡ ፍኖቶሙ ።
sentences.l: And-they-loaded to-go carts and-horses and-mules, and-was-opened their-road.
sentences.i: They loaded up to go, with carts and horses and mules, and their road was made open.
sentences.n: ወጸዐኑ 'and they loaded' (ጸዐነ 'load, carry', 3mpl perfect). ከመ ይሖሩ 'that they go'. ሰረገላተ ወአፍራሰ ወአብቅልተ 'carts and horses and mules' (accusatives; ሰረገላ is a chariot or wagon). ወተሠርሐ ፍኖቶሙ 'and their road was opened / made straight' (ተሠርሐ passive; ፍኖት 'road' + -ሆሙ).

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ አርትዑ ፡ ሐዊረ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሚካኤል ፡ መልአክ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ቅድመ ፤
sentences.l: And-after-this they-set-straight to-go while Michael angel goes before;
sentences.i: And after this they set off straight on their way, with the angel Michael going before them;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and after this'. አርትዑ ሐዊረ 'they went right on / set out straight' (አርትዐ 'make straight', with the infinitive of ሖረ). እንዘ ሚካኤል መልአክ የሐውር ቅድመ 'while Michael the angel goes before' (እንዘ + imperfect makes a circumstantial clause; ቅድመ 'before, in front').

sentences.t: በባሕርኒ ፡ ስፊሖ ፡ አኬዶሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ የብስ ፡ ወበየብስኒ ፡ ሠጢቆ ፡ ደመና ፡ አንጦሊዖ ፡ ሰወሮሙ ፡ ላህበ ፡ ፀሐይ ፤
sentences.l: In-the-sea-too spreading (?) he-made-them-walk like dry-land, and-on-dry-land-too drawing-out a-cloud overshadowing he-hid-them from-blaze-of sun;
sentences.i: In the sea he spread out (?) and made them walk as on dry land, and on dry land he stretched out a cloud and overshadowed them, hiding them from the blaze of the sun;
sentences.n: Gerunds (ስፊሖ, ሠጢቆ, አንጦሊዖ: 'having spread', etc.) are used for the manner of the action, and the finite verbs are አኬዶሙ 'he made them walk' (አኬደ, causative of ኬደ 'walk, tread', k-y-d, the root of ተካየደ) and ሰወሮሙ 'he hid them' (ሰወረ). ስፊሖ 'spreading it/him out' (?) — the object is not named. The sea-crossing is like the Exodus (Exodus 14:21–22, dry ground in the sea); the cloud, Exodus 13:21 and Psalm 105:39. ከመ የብስ 'like dry land'. በባሕርኒ, ወበየብስኒ 'on the sea indeed / on the dry land indeed' (-ኒ marks the contrast). ላህበ ፀሐይ 'the blaze of the sun' (accusative, construct).

sentences.t: ሰረገላቲሆሙኒ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘይስሕቦ ፡ አላ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ በሰረገላ ፡ ተልዒሎ ፡ እምድር ፡ መጠነ ፡ እመት ፡ እመሂ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ አፍራስ ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ አብቅልት ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ ራኵባት ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ጽዑናን ፡ ይትሌዐል ፡ እምዘባናቲሆሙ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ስዝረ ፡ ብእሲ ፤
sentences.l: Their-carts-too, no one who-draws-it, but it-goes itself in-cart, lifted from-ground to-the-measure-of a-cubit, whether man or horses or mules or beasts-of-burden (?), and-all who are-loaded rise from-their-backs to-the-measure-of a-span (?)-of man;
sentences.i: Their carts, too, had none to pull them, but each went of itself (?), lifted from the ground by about a cubit, men or horses or mules or beasts of burden (?); and all who were loaded were raised from their backs (?) by about a man's span (?);
sentences.n: ሰረገላቲሆሙኒ 'their carts too' (ሰረገላ + -ቲሆሙ). አልቦ ዘይስሕቦ 'there is none who pulls it' (ሰሐበ); አላ 'but'. የሐውር ለሊሁ በሰረገላ: ለሊሁ is 'himself/itself', so 'it goes of itself in the cart' (?), or the angel goes himself with the carts (?). ተልዒሎ is the gerund of ተለዐለ 'be lifted up', used circumstantially ('being lifted'), እምድር 'from the earth'. መጠነ እመት 'to the extent of a cubit' (እመት). እመሂ ... ወእመሂ 'whether ... or'. ራኵባት 'beasts of burden (?)' (plural of ራኩብ, glossed so in ch. 24). ጽዑናን 'the loaded'. ይትሌዐል 'rises', እምዘባናቲሆሙ 'from their backs' (ዘባን). መጠነ ስዝረ ብእሲ: ስዝር I take as a measure like a span or stride (?), 'the size of a man's ...'. The uncertainty is noted in all three.

sentences.t: ኵሉንዋየ ፡ ቊስቋሶሙዘጽዑንወእለ ፡ ይጼዐኑ ፡ ይትሌዐሉ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ስዝረ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ወእንስሳኒ ፡ ይትሌዐሉ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ስዝረ ፡ ብእሲ ፤
sentences.l: All goods-of-their ቊስቋስ (?) which-loaded, and-those who carry rise to-the-measure-of a-span-of man, and-the-beasts-too rise to-the-measure-of a-span-of man;
sentences.i: All the goods of their ቊስቋስ wares (?) that were loaded, and those who carried them (?), rose by about a man's span (?), and the beasts also rose by about a man's span (?);
sentences.n: SOURCE ODDITY: ኵሉንዋየ ቊስቋሶሙዘጽዑንወእለ is printed with missing wordspaces; read ኵሉ ንዋየ ቊስቋሶሙ ዘጽዑን ወእለ ይጼዐኑ 'all the goods of their ቊስቋስ which are loaded, and those who carry' (ይጼዐኑ, 3mp imperfect, active, as in the published glossary: the bearers, as against the 'loaded' goods) (?). ቊስቋስ is unknown to me (?), a kind of ware as in ch. 49 (ቊስቋሳት). ዘጽዑን 'which are loaded' (a passive participle). ይትሌዐሉ 'they rise, are lifted' (plural). ወእንስሳኒ 'and the beasts too' (እንስሳ). The point is that everything, goods, people and animals, was lifted alike.

sentences.t: ወኵሉ ፡ ይረውጽ ፡ በሰረገላ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሐመር ፡ በውስተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ያነውኃ ፡ ነፋስ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ጽግነት ፡ በውስተ ፡ አየር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ያሰርሖ ፡ ፍትወተ ፡ ከርሡለበሊዕ ፡ እምአብያጺሁ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ንስር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ያቀልልሥጋሁ ፡ በመልዕልተ ፡ ነፉስ ፤
sentences.l: And-all it-runs in-cart like ship in-sea when it-makes-it-sail wind, and-like ጽግነት (?) in air when it-makes-it-hasten desire-of its-belly for-eating from-its-አብያጽ (?), and-like eagle when it-lightens its-flesh in-height-of wind;
sentences.i: And everything ran along in the cart like a ship on the sea when the wind makes it sail, and like a ... (?) in the air when the appetite of its belly for food drives it from its ... (?), and like an eagle when it lightens its body high above the wind (?);
sentences.n: SOURCE ODDITIES: ከርሡለበሊዕ is printed as one word, read ከርሡ ለበሊዕ 'its belly, for eating', and ያቀልልሥጋሁ as one, read ያቀልል ሥጋሁ 'it lightens its flesh'; ነፉስ is printed for 'wind' (ነፋስ), a misprint kept as printed (or ነፍስ?). ይረውጽ 'runs' (ሮጸ). ከመ ሐመር በውስተ ባሕር 'like a ship in the sea'; ሶበ ያነውኃ ነፋስ 'when the wind makes it sail' (አነወኀ). ጽግነት: unknown (?), a bird or flying thing; ሶበ ያሰርሖ 'when it makes it hasten' (?); ፍትወተ ከርሡ 'the desire of its belly'; እምአብያጺሁ is unclear (?). ንስር 'eagle'; በመልዕልተ ነፋስ 'above the wind'.

sentences.t: ከማሁ ፡ ይረውጹ ፡ በሰረገላ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ወድኅረ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ተሀውኮ ፡ ይምነ ፡ ወፅግመ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: Likewise they-run in-cart which-without before and-behind, without shaking, right or left. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: Likewise they ran along in the cart, without pitching forward or back (?), without jolting, to the right or to the left. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.n: ከማሁ 'likewise'. ዘአልቦ ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'which has no before or after' (hence 'no lurching forward or back'). ዘእንበለ ተሀውኮ 'without disturbance, shaking' (ተሀውኮ, a verbal noun of ተሀውከ). ይምነ ወፅግመ 'to the right and to the left'. The eight ፨ close the part; the journey goes on in the next part.
